job.title: CSSD Manager

Brand-new hospital environment – modern facilities, new equipment and the opportunity to help shape how the service operates.

Already busy and growing – this isn't a CSSD waiting for the hospital to get started. The facility has hit the ground running, creating an exciting and genuinely fast-paced environment.

Supportive team & leadership – join a collaborative environment where your experience and ideas will be valued.

Sunshine Coast lifestyle – swap the daily grind for beaches, sunshine and an incredible coastal lifestyle. Think morning swims, weekend beach days, hinterland escapes and a much more relaxed pace outside of work.

About You
We're looking for an experienced CSSD professional who is ready to take the next step into a leadership role — or an established CSSD leader looking for a fresh challenge.

You'll ideally have:
  • Previous CSSD leadership/management experience
  • Strong knowledge of sterilisation, decontamination and instrument management
  • Excellent understanding of relevant Australian Standards and infection prevention requirements
  • Strong organisational and people-management skills
  • A collaborative, hands-on leadership style
